action_instruction: Reading the service fee from the GreenLeaf Market card
intent: the service fee amount in the GreenLeaf Market card

action_params.condition: the GreenLeaf Market card shows a service fee of "$3.99"
action_params.query: the service fee amount in the GreenLeaf Market card

action_instruction: Reading the service fee from the BulkBarn Wholesale card
intent: the service fee amount in the BulkBarn Wholesale card

action_params.condition: the BulkBarn Wholesale card shows a service fee of "$5.49"
action_params.query: the service fee amount in the BulkBarn Wholesale card

assertion_tree.description: the GreenLeaf Market card shows a service fee of "$3.99" and the BulkBarn Wholesale card shows a service fee of "$5.49"

sub_results.description: the GreenLeaf Market card shows a service fee of "$3.99"
the BulkBarn Wholesale card shows a service fee of "$5.49"

assertion_tree.verification: The current page shows the specified service fees on both merchant cards.
